name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) only requires holding_box at or after the fall; it does not require picking the box up again. Because holding_box is a lasting condition and box_fell is a one-step event, this Response cannot close if holding_box becomes true before the episode ends. The task requires a pickup after each fall; use ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) to require it on the very next step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` is missing. “Carry the box to the exit” requires holding it when reaching the exit, not continuously before then. Add hard `Response(at_exit, holding_box)`; keep the hard `Existence(at_exit)` and `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)`. The existing `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` is correct for the exit condition.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` is missing. The task says to carry the box to the exit, which requires `holding_box` at the exit; the current `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` allows holding it later instead. Replace it with `Response(at_exit, holding_box)`? Actually the task also requires pickup after each fall, but specifies no timing, so `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` adds an unstated next-step requirement. Use `RespondedExistence(box_fell, holding_box)` instead.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require a pickup after a fall. Because holding_box is a lasting condition, the response can be satisfied by carrying the box on the episode’s last step, even if it fell earlier and was never picked up again. The task requires picking it up again after each fall; use ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) to require pickup on the very next step.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box when reaching it, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking the box up again after every fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again.
